thought.text:
need to create a task list. Let's plan the work.
</think>

task_list.title: Update databricks.yml with required variables and include patterns
task_list.notes: Add pipeline_schema, volume, bronze_target_schema, silver_target_schema variables. Update include to use recursive patterns like resources/**/*.yml

task_list.title: Create demo/resources/jobs/consumer_job.yml
task_list.notes: Job with file_arrival trigger on /Volumes/{catalog}/{pipeline_schema}/{volume}/consumer/, tasks bronze then silver, referencing flat resource keys

task_list.title: Create demo/resources/pipelines/consumer/consumer_bronze_pipeline.yml
task_list.notes: Serverless DLT pipeline, target consumer_bronze, catalog ${var.catalog}, libraries with landing.py and bronze.py, configuration includes catalog, pipeline_schema, volume, target_schema=consumer_bronze

task_list.title: Create demo/resources/pipelines/consumer/consumer_silver_pipeline.yml
task_list.notes: Serverless DLT pipeline, target consumer_silver, catalog ${var.catalog}, libraries with silver.py, configuration includes catalog, pipeline_schema, volume, target_schema=consumer_silver

task_list.title: Create demo/src/bootstrap/setup.ipynb with consumer mapping
task_list.notes: Use base JSON notebook template, ensure input_file_paths includes 'consumer': 'consumer/'

task_list.title: Create demo/resources/jobs/bootstrap_job.yml with consumer task
task_list.notes: Use base YAML template, include setup task and run_consumer_job task that depends on setup, referencing consumer_workflow job

task_list.title: Verify logical consistency and file structure
task_list.notes: Check variable references, resource key flattening, no module-level SQL, and that all required files exist
